Step 3: The original parabola has the equation $y = x^2 - 4$. To rotate this parabola $60^\circ$ counterclockwise around the origin, we can use the rotation matrix:

$\begin{bmatrix} \cos(60^\circ) & -\sin(60^\circ) \\ \sin(60^\circ) & \cos(60^\circ) \end{bmatrix}$
